shadows.name: overlay-light
shadows.purpose: Lift the settings panel, conversation menus, and open mobile history drawer above light surfaces.

shadows.name: overlay-dark
shadows.purpose: Lift the settings panel, conversation menus, and open mobile history drawer above dark surfaces.

shadows.name: composer
shadows.purpose: Separate the composer slightly from the reading area.

motion.name: mobile-drawer
motion.purpose: Slide the conversation drawer into view.

components.name: Send / stop button
components.description: Sends a non-empty draft; switches to a stop control while a response is generating. The dark theme uses button-primary-dark and a dark stop-icon foreground on the pale error fill.
components.html: <button class="ds-send" type="button" aria-label="Send message"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 19V5"/><path d="m5 12 7-7 7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-send { display: grid; width: 31px; height: 31px; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; color: #fff; background: #657564; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, transform 120ms ease; } .ds-send:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #536653; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } :host-context([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-send:not(:disabled) { color: #20251f; background: #a6b49f; } .ds-send:disabled { color: var(--text-muted); background: var(--surface-muted); cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-send-stop { color: #fff !important; background: var(--error) !important; } :host-context([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-send-stop { color: #20251f !important; }

components.name: Icon button
components.description: Provides a compact secondary navigation or message action; the dark theme uses button-ghost-dark.
components.html: <button class="ds-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="Open conversations menu"><svg aria-hidden="true" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="19" height="19" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M4 5h16"/><path d="M4 12h16"/><path d="M4 19h16"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-icon-button { display: inline-grid; width: 29px; height: 29px; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--text-secondary); background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-icon-button:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--surface-muted); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Composer field
components.description: Captures a one-line question or growing multi-line draft, up to 220px before scrolling.
components.css: .ds-composer { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px; min-height: 54px; padding: 10px 10px 9px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgb(26 30 21 / 4%); transition: border-color 120ms ease, box-shadow 120ms ease; } .ds-composer textarea { flex: 1; min-width: 0; min-height: 26px; max-height: 220px; resize: none; overflow-y: auto; padding: 4px 0 2px; border: 0; outline: 0; color: var(--text); background: transparent; font: 12px/1.6 "Source Sans 3 Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 65%, var(--border)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 12%, transparent); } .ds-composer textarea::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); }

components.name: Model selector
components.description: Chooses an application-listed model and can show streaming, vision, or attachment capability labels. The dark theme uses model-control-dark.
components.css: .ds-model { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; min-width: 0; height: 34px; padding: 0 29px 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 7px; color: var(--text); background: var(--surface); } .ds-model-label { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; max-width: 280px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--text-secondary); font-size: 10.5px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-model-label > span { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-model-label small { flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--text-secondary); background: var(--surface-soft); font-size: 8px; } .ds-model select { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; width: 100%; height: 100%; opacity: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-model select:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-model > svg { position: absolute; right: 9px; color: var(--text-muted); pointer-events: none; } .ds-model:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: History navigation row
components.description: Marks the selected local conversation in the history rail; the dark theme uses history-navigation-dark.
components.css: .ds-history { width: 252px; padding: 4px; background: var(--sidebar); } .ds-history-current { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 39px; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: 5px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; color: var(--text); background: var(--sidebar-hover); text-align: left; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-history-current small { margin-top: 1px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 9.5px; } .ds-history-current:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Message stream
components.description: Keeps assistant prose on the reading surface and gives user turns a compact tinted bubble; the dark theme uses message-stream-dark.
components.html:
You

Explain this result.

Kalam

Here is a careful explanation.
components.css: .ds-message-stream { padding: 24px 24px 34px; color: var(--text); font: 400 13px/1.75 "Source Sans 3 Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-message { width: min(740px, 100%); margin: 0 auto; } .ds-message + .ds-message { margin-top: 27px; } .ds-label { margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .15px; } .ds-message p { margin: 0; } .ds-user p { display: table; max-width: min(680px, 91%); padding: 9px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px 12px 12px; background: var(--surface-soft); } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-message-stream { padding: 21px 15px 26px; } .ds-message { width: 100%; } .ds-message + .ds-message { margin-top: 22px; } .ds-message p { font-size: 12.5px; } }

components.name: Suggested prompt
components.description: Places a suggested prompt in the composer draft; prompts stack at narrow mobile widths. The dark theme uses suggestion-prompt-dark.
components.css: .ds-suggestion { display: inline-flex; min-height: 34px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 7px; color: var(--text-secondary); background: var(--surface); font: inherit; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms ease, background 120ms ease; } .ds-suggestion:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); color: var(--text); background: var(--surface-soft); } .ds-suggestion:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-suggestion span { color: var(--text-muted); } @media (max-width: 380px) { .ds-suggestion { width: 100%; justify-content: space-between; } }

components.name: Code block
components.description: Presents fenced code with a language label, copy control, and scrollable preformatted region; syntax colors follow the selected theme, with dark tokens kept at least 4.5:1 against the charcoal surface.
components.css: .ds-code { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; background: #f8f8f6; } .ds-code-toolbar { display: flex; min-height: 31px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 9px 0 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-muted); font: 9.5px ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-code-toolbar button { display: flex; height: 24px; align-items: center; padding: 0 5px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--text-secondary); background: transparent; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-code-toolbar button:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--surface-muted); } .ds-code pre { max-width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 12px 14px; overflow: auto; color: #343630; background: transparent; font: 400 11px/1.65 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace; tab-size: 2; white-space: pre; } .ds-code code { font: inherit; } :host-context([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-code { background: #252622; } :host-context([data-theme="dark"]) .ds-code pre { color: #deded7; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-code pre { font-size: 10px; } }

narrative.overview:
Kalam gives technical conversations a quiet reading workspace. Graphite is the default canvas, with warm paper in light mode and muted sage for actions and selected state. Fine borders and tonal surfaces separate controls without turning the conversation into a dashboard of cards.

Self-hosted Source Sans 3 Variable carries interface text, headings, prompts, and answers; monospace is reserved for code. The small Georgia italic `k` belongs only to the wordmark mark, while interface controls use Lucide icons. Local history sits beside one centered conversation column.
keyCharacteristics: Dark by default, with a warm-paper light theme.
Muted sage marks actions and selected states.
A narrow history rail frames a wide technical reading column.
Monospace is reserved for code and its language labels.

rules.name: The Sage Action Rule
rules.body: Use sage for actions and selected states. Keep the surrounding surface neutral.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Theme-specific secondary and supporting text must meet 4.5:1 against the paper or graphite surfaces where they appear.

dos: Do keep Source Sans 3 Variable for interface text, headings, and conversation prose.
Do use monospace only for code and measured data.
Do use sage for actions and selected states, not as a decorative wash across the whole page.
Do keep reading content in a centered measure no wider than 740px.
Do keep the composer surface flat; it has no gradient.
donts: Don't use gradients or decorative AI effects.
Don't add provider branding or provider-specific details to the frontend.
Don't put every message or control inside a card.
Don't use secondary text below 4.5:1 contrast on its actual surface.
Don't extend the localized Georgia italic `k` into a display-serif heading style.
